state.objective: Judge two planned language decisions for agent-written software. Human comfort carries no independent weight. Successful behavior and dependable refactors come first, with whole-task token cost measured afterward. The project has no outside users and may replace old syntax freely. Emitted TS must delegate equivalent operations to JavaScript/Bun, adding adapters only for language guarantees. Advice concerns design preparation rather than delivery.
state.error_evidence: Today an author writes error 1000000 payment_declined(str reason) and maintains the corresponding registry allocation. Independently developed owners collide because active and retired integers are globally reserved at load, check and runtime boundaries. Actual type matching, error bounds and assertions distinguish qualified symbols and instantiated arguments. The terminal emits a number plus full typeIdentity without revealing protected payloads. Source inspection found no consumer demanding standalone integer interpretation between locked builds or stability through declaration renaming. Both candidates require the full compiler-to-report migration, while internal built-in numeric metadata need not disappear.
state.error_contract: Require composition of two separately written dependencies once each uses the new design, with no joint numbering agreement or link-time source rewrite. Maintain owner-qualified and generic-specialization distinctions as well as redaction and deterministic reports. Specify owner scope and the treatment of renamed or retired declarations. Moving a checkout must not alter identity; adding a foreign dependency cannot collapse identities. Retain enough artifacts to interpret reports from two locked builds. If compact numbers appear, label their build and archive their inverse map rather than treating the number as a type.
state.action_evidence: A factored baseline uses ordinary helpers for route construction, status and HTML, with raw-form types and finite results; the invoice probe passed 18 assertions. That run established no live HTTP, persisted writes or browser swaps. Existing URL/target safety cannot identify a particular action. Independent route/method occurrences and form-error/control strings may become inconsistent without static rejection. A source declaration and a checked manifest could each close these gaps with identical semantics, but neither has been built or measured on agent tasks. Both demand checking, emission, catalogue and runtime adapters; other static descriptors do not already supply this feature.
state.action_contract: Test only the exact POST /invoice/edit first: query invoice_key, shallow string invoice_form, maximum 2048 bytes, result edit_outcome. Its five leaves saved/invalid/conflict/forbidden/unavailable retain HTTP 200/422/409/403/503 respectively and request inner swaps. Resolve one action identity from its package instance and declaration for the route builder, method, form, handler binding and exhaustive status table. Typed direct field handles retain wire ownership; strict decoding addresses unknown names and duplicate scalar fields. This gives no authorization, target-existence, commit or retry proof: server-owned authentication/CSRF plus tenant/revision enforcement and observed browser/database tests remain obligations. Reject server mounts on browser targets. Do not bundle typed captures, row forms, components or typed DOM regions into this decision.
state.action_tradeoffs: One candidate introduces an action declaration next to source types, contextual parser sections, resolvable exported static symbols and checked catalogue consumption. Such symbols must not be unconstrained mutable values. Another records the same contract in JSON and synthesizes ordinary URL/post/mount members. Although it avoids new Can grammar, it needs typed manifest references, owner-environment resolution, namespace-collision/privacy rules and file/key diagnostics across two authoring surfaces. A helpers-only approach introduces neither surface and relies on centralized code plus protocol tests for the untyped endpoint/string relationships. Any efficiency judgment must compare creation, renaming and repair with that factored baseline; these candidates have no task-token measurements.

application_error_identity.instructions: Which application error contract should engineering specify now to remove cross-owner allocation conflicts while retaining the required reporting and nominal guarantees?

criteria.qualified_text: Use error payment_declined(str reason) with no source-assigned application code or parallel active numeric list. Base reporting on explicit canonical qualified declaration keys and instantiated types. Renamed declarations get different identities; old locked-build reports remain decodable. Permit only mapped build-specific compact integers and specify textual retirement/reuse without duplicating active allocations.
criteria.owner_number: Retain the numbered declaration error 1000000 payment_declined(str reason) and active/retired bookkeeping per owning project. Allow identical integers in unrelated projects, qualify report codes by owner and retain full instantiated type identity. This supports owner-local stable numbers and retirement, at the cost of writing the allocation in source and registry.

action_contract_placement.instructions: What design should engineering specify for action authoring in this bounded workload, considering static repair guarantees and full implementation cost under the stated evidence limits?

criteria.source_action: Specify a Can action declaration containing the bounded route/input/result/policy table, producing an exportable static action identity. Catalogue action::url, action::post and action::mount operate on it. Build the common exact-route guarantees with the existing helper pattern as control; path captures remain a separate increment.
criteria.checked_manifest: Choose typed manifest action metadata, binding Can type/case names and generating ordinary save_invoice_url/save_invoice_post/save_invoice_mount APIs. This supplies the identical bounded semantic checks via a second authoring surface, with no action declaration syntax. Compare helper controls and keep captures out of the initial scope.
criteria.ordinary_helpers: Continue with existing URL/status/form/render helpers plus external observations, deferring both new action surfaces. Declare the absence of exact endpoint typing and static string-link checks, and require more baseline/agent evidence before introducing either dedicated mechanism.
